title: tofu plan fails inside a golden module (service account id with a trailing dash): a platform defect, not developer remediation
source: example 01 live run 11-12 SA-ACCOUNT-ID-TRIM (register row): two regenerations that could not change the golden module
mechanism: M1 developer by default on the deploy side (an empty deploy class is remediable) + M7 identifier derivation

deploy.note: attempts[n].result = the failed result before routing (what a server without the owner router sends: status FAILED, the engine's text, no class); engine_plan_stream = the read-only re-plan's `plan -json` stream of the same error. The terraform server's own routing code runs on them (tests/scenario_tf_route_child.py).
